```yaml
name: Test Cookiecutter Template

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12]
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    - name: Run pytest
      run: pytest

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tortoise-beanie: ['tortoise', 'beanie']
        docker: ['true', 'false']
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Set up Python 3.9
      uses: actions/setup-python@v4
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
    
    - name: Generate project
      run: |
        uv sync --template .
    
    - name: Check file structure
      run: |
        find . -type f | grep -E '\.(py|txt|md)$' > files.txt
        cat files.txt
    
    - name: Check Python syntax
      run: |
        find . -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +
    
    - name: Replace template variables
      run: |
        grep -rl '{{cookiecutter.' .} | xargs sed -i '' 's/{{cookiecutter\..*}}//g'
    
    - name: Install uv dependencies
      run: |
        uv sync --install-only
    
    - name: Import basic modules
      run: |
        python -c "import fastapi; import uvicorn"
```
